<translate>
The '''Hyperbolic Time Chamber''' (the Room of Spirit and Time, dimension id <code>dragonminez:time_chamber</code>) is a boundless white void built for one thing: '''training'''. Its gravity is ten times stronger than Earth's and every Training Point you earn inside is multiplied, which makes it the best place to grind [[Special:MyLanguage/Training Points and Mastery|Training Points and form mastery]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Gravity ==
</translate>
{{Config|Gravity Config|gravityPerWorld}}
<translate>
The chamber has '''×10''' gravity by default, the highest of any DragonMineZ dimension. Everything is heavier here: movement, jumping and flight are all weighed down, which is exactly what makes it a training ground.
</translate>

<translate>
== Environment ==
</translate>
<translate>
The whole dimension is a flat, endless expanse of '''Time Chamber Block''' under a blank sky. There are no ores and no natural mobs: you bring your own training. You arrive in the chamber's '''entry building''', where [[Special:MyLanguage/Mr. Popo|Mr. Popo]] waits next to a Punch Machine and the portal back to [[Special:MyLanguage/Kami's Lookout|Kami's Lookout]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Training ==
</translate>
{{Config|General Server Config|HTCTpMultiplier}}
<translate>
* Every Training Point you earn inside the chamber is multiplied by '''×1.75''' by default, on top of your other TP boosts. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Training Points and Mastery|Training Points and Mastery]].
* The chamber's gravity still amplifies your [[Special:MyLanguage/Weights|weights]], but it doesn't add the flat gravity TP bonus: the chamber's own TP multiplier replaces it.
* Inside the chamber, [[Special:MyLanguage/Mr. Popo|Mr. Popo]] offers '''Train''': a Shadow Clone to spar with, or the '''Rhythm''' [[Special:MyLanguage/Training Minigames|training minigame]]. He only offers it here.
</translate>

{{Note|type=tip|title=<translate>Tip</translate>|<translate>A fast training loop: wear weights inside the chamber with a TP Multiplier effect active, and break it up with master minigames and a Shadow Dummy, which also trains form mastery.</translate>}}

<translate>
== Getting there ==
</translate>
<translate>
* Use the '''Time Chamber portal''' at [[Special:MyLanguage/Kami's Lookout|Kami's Lookout]] on Earth. The portal in the entry building takes you back to the Lookout.
* Or travel by [[Special:MyLanguage/Space Pod|Space Pod]] once you complete Bulma's ''Temporal Comm-Link'' sidequest. The pod lands at the chamber's entry point (0.5, 130, 0.5).
</translate>

{{Note|type=warning|<translate>Spirits on a temporary return from [[Special:MyLanguage/Fortuneteller Baba|Fortuneteller Baba]] burn their remaining time five times faster in the chamber. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld#Fortuneteller Baba's temporary return|Otherworld]].</translate>}}

<translate>
In the story, the [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]] has you fight Super Buu inside the chamber.
</translate>
